findings.summary: The fsync fix (work_head 4a8f769) closes the single major finding from rf-d72ac585. Journal.append/append_many now route through _persist_append (write -> flush -> file_sync -> dir_sync on first file creation), file_sync/dir_sync are injectable seams defaulting to os.fsync, and a sync failure raises before submit ACKs or any external effect starts. Verified by static inspection; TestDurableJournalSync adds six offline tests (fsync-before-ACK, single-fsync batch, sync-failure abort, no-ACK-on-sync-failure, directory-entry sync, effect-only-after-intent-fsync).

Read-only review could not execute `git diff 4a8f769 0d9e3e88 -- . ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'`. Product-tree equality between work_head_commit (4a8f769) and subject_commit (0d9e3e88) excluding .dev-dispatch is corroborated by the worktree reflog, which shows 0d9e3e88 as an empty-message 'uther' materializer commit directly atop 4a8f769 ('fix(goal): fsync journal appends before ACK and external effects') with no intervening product commit. Definitive mechanical verification remains with the deterministic seal.
